name: Svarog
title: Father of Fire
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Blacksmith of the gods, Svarog forged much of Vyraj itself. That creation is imperfect has always eaten at him, and the Shattering has only salted that wound. Furious at Chaos and Destiny both, he is among the most vocal champions of Order, and seeks nothing less than the opportunity to recreate the world in its most perfect potential form.
